source: Windows test VM, Kontakt 8 + Spitfire Symphony Orchestra, 2026-10-15: MuseScore3Evo.exe --verify-playback --verify-wav (build 435, run https://github.com/Celeste-fr/MS3-MS4playback-SSO/actions/runs/38810472364) of performance_context/grid_score.py's scores, each part rendered alone through the hosted plug-ins, Recommended with slurs/transitionsEarly 1 (the current default) and, cancelling in held - slurred, sectionBalance / realRange / micCompensation 0, evenLevels 0; the map's contextLevel zeroed in the VM's copy
metric: P: ArticulationCheck::perceivedLoudnessDb (perceived.py) from the note-on as sent to the next note-on (or its end + 0.3 s); L: loudest 50 ms RMS (5 ms hop, mono) from the note-on to max(off, on + 150 ms) + 50 ms; median per figure, per take (A, B: B in reverse order)
figure: held: four half notes [p, p-2, p+2, p] at q = 60, All techniques Long at CC1 = d; slurred: two touching slurs of four sixteenths [p, p-2, p, p+1] [p, p+2, p, p-1] at the IOI, Performance Legato at CC1 = d (a smooth first note, fingered within, bowed into the second slur, transitions sent by their modelled arrival)

rule.note: gain dB over the Performance Legato at CC1 = d for a slur of median IOI ioiMs and median pitch p: the section's All techniques Long held at CC1 = d less the slurred figure at CC1 = d (metric P); key "d|ioiMs|p"
